''[[Star Wars: Smugglers Gambit]]'' takes place after the events of {{Film|VI}} and prior to the events of {{Film|VII}}, which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[4 ABY]] and [[34 ABY]], respectively. Therefore, ''Star Wars: Smugglers Gambit''{{#if: {{{1|}}}|, including {{{1}}},|}} must take place between 4 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]] and 34 ABY.<noinclude>
